algorithm.description: Signature algorithm identifier, e.g. an ML-DSA or SLH-DSA parameter set. Deliberately not constrained to an enum here: ADR-0002 requires algorithms to be replaceable through explicit, delayed, auditable governance, so the accepted set lives in the signature-suite registry rather than in this schema, where changing it would be a schema break.

suiteVersion.description: Version of the signature suite that produced this signature. Required by SPEC.md. Constrained to dotted integers because downgrade resistance requires versions to be orderable: a validator must be able to decide that an offered suite is older than the minimum it will accept, which is not possible over free-form strings.

signer.description: Identifier resolving to the verification material for this signature. An identifier rather than an inline key: PQC public keys are large, and SPEC.md requires stable identity with rotatable authorization keys, which an indirection supports and an inline key does not.

value.description: Encoded signature over the canonical envelope.

signature.description: Authorization for this envelope. SPEC.md requires a signature algorithm identifier, a signature-suite version, and verification material.
